reason: Guarded-renderer activation events (spec 028 S17-S19), cumulative since baseline 0.0.0 and superseding declaration 034 (its deltas remain as declared there). New deltas are purely additive on @kimen/elements: the six form controls (ki-checkbox, ki-switch, ki-radio-group, ki-select, ki-input, ki-textarea) now declare in their component contract the composed native change event they already re-dispatched from the host, through an @event JSDoc tag the agent-surfaces build carries into the Custom Elements Manifest, llms.txt and the catalog. Zero removals; zero value changes; no runtime behavior of any component changes and the generated wrappers are byte-identical.
